solutions.title: Memoized prefix search
solutions.strategy: Try dictionary words at each suffix start and memoize whether the remaining suffix can be segmented.

timeComplexity.explanation: There are n start positions; each may try w distinct dictionary words, and each prefix comparison can inspect up to l characters.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Memo and recursion depth are bounded by string positions, and the distinct dictionary word list stores w entries.

solutions.title: Bottom-up DP
solutions.strategy: Let dp[i] mean the prefix ending before i can be segmented, then scan split points for each end.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each reachable start position can try w distinct dictionary words, and each prefix comparison can inspect up to l characters.

spaceComplexity.explanation: One boolean reachability state is stored for every prefix length, plus the distinct dictionary word list.
